event.title: Greenpeace Unveils Giant Trojan Horse of Plastic Waste at COP31
event.canonical_title: Greenpeace Unveils Giant Trojan Horse of Plastic Waste at COP31
event.summary: During the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, Greenpeace International unveiled a giant Trojan Horse overflowing with plastic waste. The installation, created by Danish artist Thomas Dambo, serves as a striking protest highlighting the environmental impact of plastics.
